text: Extensions Hub 为 DSH Web 提供插件目录入口，在侧边栏和主界面显示扩展中心；宿主缺少标准插槽时改用页脚入口和覆盖层。目录搜索 GitHub 上带 dsh-plugin 主题的仓库，失败时尝试 ghfast 镜像，再显示内置精选列表。用户可按名称、描述或仓库名筛选，打开仓库并复制 DSH Web 安装命令。Skills 和 MCP 页签只展示说明。适合希望在 DSH 中发现插件并复制安装命令的 Web 用户。

Extensions Hub adds a searchable plugin catalog to DSH Web. It finds GitHub dsh-plugin repositories, with a ghfast mirror and curated list as fallbacks. Users can filter entries, open repositories, and copy install commands. Skills and MCP tabs show documentation only.
想在 DSH 里浏览和搜索可安装的插件目录
能不能在 DSH Web 里找到 GitHub 上的 DSH 插件并复制安装命令
I want to discover DSH plugins from inside the web client and copy an install command
Extensions Hub 的功能「插件目录」：搜索 GitHub 插件仓库，支持筛选、打开仓库和复制 DSH Web 安装命令；搜索无结果时改用镜像或精选列表。
Extensions Hub 使用前须知：目录搜索会请求 api.github.com；没有结果时还会请求 ghfast.top 镜像。（见 src/client/catalog.ts:31-32、124-128）

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-extensionshub README · @haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-extensionshub：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Haibala DeepSeek Harness web plugin that lists GitHub repositories tagged [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin). The page copies an official install command; it does not run `dsh plugin add` inside the browser.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-extensionshub README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-extensionshub
```

Restart `dsh web` (or the desktop shell) after the add succeeds. This repository ships prebuilt `lib/`, so the first install does not need a pnpm `allowBuilds` entry.

The previous repository name `haibala-aii/dsh-haibala-ui-extensions` redirects here.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-extensionshub README · Where it appears：A third-party bundle cannot add new holes to AppFrame or SidebarRoot. Those parents alone may declare `sidebar.nav` and `shell.surface`.

This plugin therefore:

- occupies `sidebar.nav` + `shell.surface` when the host already declares them
- otherwise occupies the official additive seats: a **Extensions** row on `sidebar.footer.action` (above Settings) and a full-frame `shell.overlay` catalog
@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-extensionshub README · Where it appears：Stock DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.5` has the official seats, so the GitHub install works there without a forked shell.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-extensionshub README · What the page does：- **Plugins** — live GitHub topic search (`dsh-plugin`), then a ghfast mirror, then a curated fallback list. Each card copies:

```sh
  dsh plugin --profile web add github:owner/repo
  ```

- **Skills** — documentation only. Place `SKILL.md` files in the workspace or host skill directory.
- **MCP** — documentation only. Enable servers through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` config.
